name: Oh My Posh
summary: Cross-shell prompt engine (Go binary) with JSON/YAML/TOML themes made of blocks and segments, Go-template text, palettes, transient and right prompts.
configFormat: json (also yaml/toml); no default path, passed with --config to `oh-my-posh init <shell>`
startupCostMs: Prompt render is ~10-120 ms (oh-my-posh debug: e.g. 12 ms, 85 ms with git). Cold-start cost is dominated by PowerShell parsing the generated init script: ~1.9 s extra reported on Windows with PowerShell 7.6 and v29.14.0 (upstream issue #7539, 2026-05); a hand-cached init script still costs ~250 ms. Fixes: `async: true` in the theme, `streaming`, cache the init script. Each extra process on Windows also costs 10-60 ms (measured on this machine).

install.notes: Docs command: winget install JanDeDobbeleer.OhMyPosh --source winget (33.2.0 in the winget source on 2026-11-23).
Verified in the scoop main bucket (33.2.0); docs themselves list winget, manual and chocolatey.

windows.notes: The config path is a catalog convention: Oh My Posh has no default file, you point init at one with --config (local path, theme name, or URL; local file is fastest). Works in PowerShell 5.1/7 (`init pwsh`), Git Bash, cmd (Clink), nushell, fish and zsh. No config validator command is documented: use the JSON schema (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JanDeDobbeleer/oh-my-posh/main/themes/schema.json) in an editor, and `oh-my-posh print primary --config <file> --shell uni` to render once.

install.notes: Documented tap formula; a homebrew-core formula `oh-my-posh` (33.3.1) also exists.

macos.notes: macOS /bin/bash is 3.2; if you see 'conditional binary operator expected' install a newer bash (docs troubleshooting).

linux.notes: Official script (needs curl, unzip, realpath, dirname): `curl -s https://ohmyposh.dev/install.sh | bash -s` installs to ~/bin or ~/.local/bin; `-d <dir>` picks another. Not in the Arch/Fedora/Debian main repos as far as checked (pacman: not found in extra).

transient.notes: nu, fish, zsh, PowerShell, cmd; bash needs ble.sh.

right-prompt.notes: rprompt block: bash (ble.sh), zsh, PowerShell, cmd, nu, fish.
